forecast_target: World Bank annual real GDP, constant 2015 USD, 1985-2025

forecast_evaluation.scaler: fit on each training fold only
forecast_evaluation.gru_lstm: sequence=5 years, hidden=8, epochs=200, fixed seed per origin; exploratory due short annual series

forecast_projection.interpretation: Out-of-sample model projections based on observations through 2025; not official estimates. The displayed empirical P80 bands use absolute log errors from rolling-origin backtests at the matching horizon; time-series errors are dependent and small samples do not guarantee nominal coverage. Neural models use recursive five-step forecasts and are exploratory.

multi_horizon_backtest.method: expanding-window rolling-origin; baselines forecast in log GDP; GRU/LSTM use recursive multi-step forecasts

time_series_methods.adf: ADF with AIC lag selection; trend+constant for log level, constant for log difference
time_series_methods.decomposition: HP filter on log annual real GDP, lambda=6.25; not an official potential GDP estimate
time_series_methods.fx_volatility: 12-month rolling sample standard deviation of monthly log returns, annualized by sqrt(12)

comparisons: annual IIP/GDP contemporaneous and lagged correlation

quarterly_real_gdp_evaluation.source: NSDP / National Summary Data Page of Vietnam Statistics Office
quarterly_real_gdp_evaluation.target: Quarterly observed real GDP level, constant 2010 prices, billion VND
quarterly_real_gdp_evaluation.method: Expanding-window rolling-origin; each model is refit at each origin. Origins overlap and errors are dependent.
quarterly_real_gdp_evaluation.separate_price_base_series: 2025-Q1–2025-Q3 and 2026-Q1–2026-Q3 at constant 2020 prices; stored separately and not spliced into the constant-2010 series.
